title: BICON II
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT CONSTRUCTION & EQUIPMENT.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice of the Government’s intent to issue a solicitation for the following requirement: National Stock Number: 8150-01-586-4979 Quantity: 284 Item: CONTAINER, BICON II with one shelf and doors on both ends Location: CONUS This is not a Request for Quote and only the Government notice of intent in the near future. When the solicitation is published on DIBBS, the Government’s requirement will be fully outlined in the solicitation. All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal or quotation which shall be considered by the agency – REFERENCE – FAR 5.207 (c) (16).
